cards.description: 该研究提出RegimeRank模型，将行业轮动任务形式化为按预期风险调整主动绩效排序行业，并通过专家定义的时间特征、宏观状态条件化和跨行业依赖建模提升排序表现，同时保持可解释性。其新意在于融合宏观状态感知与注意力机制，为量化选股提供可诊断的排序工具。
cards.originalTitle: Regime-Aware Interpretable Ranking for Sector Rotation
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes RegimeRank, a model that formulates sector rotation as ranking sectors by expected future risk-adjusted active performance, and enhances ranking performance while maintaining interpretability through expert-defined temporal features, macro-regime conditioning, and cross-sector dependency modeling. Its novelty lies in integrating regime awareness with attention mechanisms to provide a diagnosable ranking tool for quantitative portfolio management.
keyPointsEn: RegimeRank represents fundamental and technical signals through expert-defined temporal characteristics and conditions them on learned macro factors via cross-attention.
The model captures cross-sector dependencies using self-attention and provides interpretability diagnostics through expected-gradient attributions and attention maps.
On weekly S&P 500 data from 2002 to 2024 under combinatorial purged cross-validation, the model outperforms baselines on multiple ranking metrics.
cards.summaryEn: The authors define sector rotation as ranking sectors by forward sector-benchmark Sharpe ratios and propose RegimeRank, an interpretable model that represents signals via expert-defined temporal characteristics, conditions on learned macro factors via cross-attention, and models cross-sector dependencies via self-attention. On weekly S&P 500 data from 2002 to 2024 under combinatorial purged cross-validation, the model outperforms representative ranking and machine-learning baselines across multiple ranking metrics. Ablation studies support the contributions of latent macro states, regime conditioning, and cross-sector modeling, while attribution and attention analyses illustrate the temporal characteristics, macro states, and sector relationships underlying its rankings.
keyPoints: RegimeRank通过专家定义的时间特征表示基本面和技术信号，并利用跨注意力对学习到的宏观因子进行条件化。
模型使用自注意力捕捉行业间依赖，并通过预期梯度归因和注意力图提供可解释性诊断。
在2002-2024年标普500周度数据上，组合净化交叉验证显示模型在多个排序指标上优于基线。
cards.limitations: 证据基于2002-2024年标普500周度数据的回测，采用组合净化交叉验证，但未涉及其他市场或资产类别；模型性能依赖于专家定义的时间特征和宏观因子学习，实际部署需考虑交易成本、容量约束和样本外稳定性；归因和注意力分析提供的是相关性诊断而非因果解释。
cards.titleEn: RegimeRank: Interpretable Ranking for Sector Rotation
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on backtests using weekly S&P 500 data from 2002 to 2024 under combinatorial purged cross-validation, without covering other markets or asset classes; model performance relies on expert-defined temporal features and learned macro factors, and practical deployment requires considering transaction costs, capacity constraints, and out-of-sample stability; attribution and attention analyses provide correlational diagnostics rather than causal explanations.
cards.summary: 作者将行业轮动任务定义为依据未来行业-基准夏普比率对行业进行排序，并提出RegimeRank模型，通过专家定义的时间特征、跨注意力宏观状态条件化和自注意力跨行业依赖建模来实现可解释排序。在2002-2024年标普500周度数据上，采用组合净化交叉验证，该模型在多个排序指标上优于代表性排序和机器学习基线。消融实验支持潜在宏观状态、状态条件化和跨行业建模的贡献，归因和注意力分析展示了排序背后的时间特征、宏观状态和行业关系。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This research offers a ranking framework for sector rotation that balances predictive performance and interpretability, helping portfolio managers understand how macro regimes and sector relationships influence active allocation decisions and supporting model diagnostics and improvement.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为行业轮动提供了一种兼顾预测性能与可解释性的排序框架，有助于投资组合经理理解宏观状态和行业关联如何影响主动配置决策，并支持模型诊断与改进。
cards.title: RegimeRank：可解释的行业轮动排序模型

cards.description: TimeART 提出一种融合强工具分析能力与大语言模型推理能力的智能体框架，用于时间序列问答（TSQA），并构建 10 万条专家轨迹数据集 TimeToolBench 及四阶段训练策略，以提升基于 LLM 的时间序列推理模型（TSRM）的工具使用与泛化能力。
cards.originalTitle: TimeART: Towards Agentic Time Series Reasoning via Tool-Augmentation
cards.descriptionEn: TimeART proposes an agentic framework that integrates powerful tool-based analysis with LLM reasoning for time series question answering (TSQA). It also introduces a 100k expert trajectory corpus, TimeToolBench, and a four-stage training strategy to enhance tool-use and generalization of LLM-based time series reasoning models (TSRMs).
keyPointsEn: TimeART fuses tool-based analysis with LLM reasoning to build a fully agentic framework for time series question answering.
The authors construct TimeToolBench, a 100k expert trajectory corpus, to train LLM-based TSRMs for strategic tool use.
A four-stage training strategy enhances TSRM generalization via early experiences and self-reflection; the 8B model achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple tasks.
cards.summaryEn: This work introduces TimeART, a framework combining strong out-of-the-box tools with LLM reasoning to serve as a fully agentic data scientist for time series question answering. The authors collect a 100k expert trajectory corpus, TimeToolBench, and devise a four-stage training strategy that enables TSRMs to learn from their own early experiences and self-reflections. Experiments show that an 8B TSRM trained on TimeToolBench and equipped with TimeART achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance across multiple TSQA tasks.
keyPoints: TimeART 融合工具分析与 LLM 推理，构建面向时间序列问答的全智能体框架。
作者构建 10 万条专家轨迹数据集 TimeToolBench，用于训练 LLM 基 TSRM 的策略性工具使用。
提出四阶段训练策略，通过早期经验和自我反思增强 TSRM 泛化能力，8B 模型在多任务上达到当前最优。
cards.limitations: 证据来自 arXiv 预印本及作者自述实验，尚未经过同行评审；性能提升仅在与特定基线对比中报告，未涵盖所有 TSQA 场景；四阶段训练策略的独立贡献缺乏消融细节；TimeToolBench 的构建质量与覆盖范围可能影响泛化结论；8B 模型之外的规模未验证。
cards.titleEn: TimeART: An Agentic Time Series Reasoning Framework via Tool Augmentation
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from an arXiv preprint and the authors' self-reported experiments, without peer review; performance gains are reported only against selected baselines and do not cover all TSQA scenarios; ablation details for the independent contribution of the four-stage training strategy are lacking; the construction quality and coverage of TimeToolBench may affect generalization conclusions; model scales beyond 8B are not validated.
cards.summary: 该工作提出 TimeART 框架，将现有强工具的分析能力与 LLM 的推理能力结合，实现全智能体的时间序列问答。作者收集 10 万条专家轨迹构成 TimeToolBench，并设计四阶段训练策略，使 TSRM 从自身早期经验和自我反思中学习。实验表明，8B 参数 TSRM 在 TimeToolBench 上训练并配备 TimeART 后，在多个 TSQA 任务上取得一致的当前最优性能。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work offers an automated agent paradigm for time series analysis, reducing reliance on human data scientists and demonstrating the potential of combining tool augmentation with training strategies to improve LLM generalization in time series reasoning.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为时间序列分析提供了一种自动化智能体范式，减少对人工数据科学家的依赖，并展示了工具增强与训练策略结合在提升 LLM 时间序列推理泛化性方面的潜力。
cards.title: TimeART：基于工具增强的智能体时间序列推理框架

cards.description: 该论文提出分支签名模型，基于分支粗糙路径理论推广经典几何粗糙路径，并证明其通用逼近定理；通过构造扩展映射将分支签名转化为经典几何签名，为粗糙波动率校准和最优执行等数据驱动建模提供计算方案。
cards.descriptionEn: This paper introduces the branched signature model, generalizing classical geometric rough paths based on branched rough path theory, and establishes a universal approximation theorem. By constructing an extension map, branched signatures are realized as classical geometric signatures of extended paths, providing a computational scheme for data-driven modeling such as rough volatility calibration and optimal execution.
keyPointsEn: Proposes the branched signature model, generalizing classical geometric rough paths, and establishes a universal approximation theorem.
Shows that iterative compositions of lower-level signature maps can approximate higher-level signatures, providing a computational scheme.
Constructs explicit path extensions using an existing extension map to realize branched signatures as classical geometric signatures.
cards.summaryEn: The authors introduce the branched signature model, extending the classical geometric rough path framework, and establish a universal approximation theorem. They also show that iterative compositions of lower-level signature maps can approximate higher-level signatures, and explicitly construct path extensions based on an existing extension map so that branched signatures can be realized as classical geometric signatures. Two applications—rough volatility calibration and optimal execution—demonstrate the framework's effectiveness, though the abstract does not report quantitative comparisons.
keyPoints: 提出分支签名模型，推广经典几何粗糙路径，并建立通用逼近定理。
证明低层签名映射的迭代组合可逼近高层签名，提供计算方案。
利用已有扩展映射显式构造路径扩展，将分支签名转化为经典几何签名。
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自论文摘要，未提供与现有方法的定量比较或实证细节；两个应用（粗糙波动率校准和最优执行）的有效性需进一步验证；扩展映射的存在性依赖已有文献，其构造细节和计算复杂度未在摘要中说明。
cards.titleEn: Branched Signature Model: Universal Approximation and Efficient Computational Framework
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to the paper's abstract, with no quantitative comparison to existing methods or empirical details provided; the effectiveness of the two applications (rough volatility calibration and optimal execution) requires further validation; the existence of the extension map relies on prior literature, and its construction details and computational complexity are not described in the abstract.
cards.summary: 作者引入分支签名模型，扩展了经典几何粗糙路径框架，并建立了通用逼近定理。他们还证明低层签名映射的迭代组合可逼近高层签名，并基于已有扩展映射显式构造路径扩展，使分支签名实现为经典几何签名。论文通过粗糙波动率校准和最优执行两个应用展示框架有效性，但摘要未报告定量比较结果。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework provides an efficient computational approach for branched signatures and may advance data-driven modeling in quantitative finance problems such as rough volatility calibration and optimal execution.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架为分支签名提供了高效计算途径，并可能推动数据驱动建模在粗糙波动率校准和最优执行等量化金融问题中的应用。
cards.title: 分支签名模型：通用逼近与高效计算框架

cards.description: 提出MOIRA框架，将配对交易建模为分层强化学习问题，用大语言模型分别参数化高层资产对选择与低层执行策略，并通过提示更新和文本反馈进行优化，无需梯度微调。
cards.originalTitle: MOIRA: Policy Memory and Belief Revision for Language-Model Agents in Non-Stationary Pair Trading
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes MOIRA, a framework that formulates pair trading as hierarchical reinforcement learning and uses large language models to parameterize both high-level pair selection and low-level execution, optimized via prompt updates and textual feedback without gradient fine-tuning.
keyPointsEn: Formulates pair trading as a hierarchical reinforcement learning problem, separating high-level pair selection from low-level execution.
Both high-level and low-level policies are parameterized by large language models and optimized solely through prompt updates, without gradient fine-tuning.
Uses trajectory- and episode-level textual feedback for credit assignment, reducing non-stationarity across hierarchy levels and enabling targeted adaptation.
cards.summaryEn: The paper studies credit assignment in hierarchical sequential decision-making, using pair trading where high-level semantic choices constrain downstream execution under delayed and ambiguous feedback. The authors propose a language-driven optimization framework in which both policies are LLM-parameterized and updated exclusively through prompts using trajectory- and episode-level textual feedback to adapt to non-stationary markets. Experiments on real market data show improvements over traditional and LLM-based baselines.
keyPoints: 将配对交易形式化为分层强化学习问题，分离高层资产对选择与低层执行。
高层与低层策略均由大语言模型参数化，仅通过提示更新优化，不进行梯度微调。
利用轨迹级和回合级文本反馈进行信用分配，减少层级间非平稳性并实现针对性适应。
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自论文所述的真实市场数据实验，未在输入中提供具体统计显著性、交易成本敏感性或不同市场阶段的稳健性检验；框架依赖LLM提示设计，其对提示质量与文本反馈粒度的敏感性未充分说明；配对交易场景的结论向其他分层决策问题的外推需谨慎。
cards.titleEn: Policy Memory and Belief Revision for Language-Model Agents in Non-Stationary Pair Trading
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to the real-market experiments described, with no specific statistical significance, transaction-cost sensitivity, or robustness checks across market regimes provided in the input; the framework depends on LLM prompt design, and its sensitivity to prompt quality and textual feedback granularity is not fully addressed; extrapolation from pair trading to other hierarchical decision problems requires caution.
cards.summary: 论文研究分层序贯决策中的信用分配难题，以配对交易为场景，高层语义选择约束下游执行且反馈延迟模糊。作者提出语言驱动的优化框架，两级策略均由LLM通过提示更新优化，利用轨迹和回合级文本反馈适应非平稳市场。实验显示在真实市场数据上优于传统及LLM基线。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work demonstrates a path for hierarchical policy learning and belief revision with language models without fine-tuning, offering an interpretable optimization approach for sequential decision-making under delayed feedback and partial observability, with relevance to strategy adaptation in quantitative trading.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作展示了无需微调即可用语言模型进行分层策略学习与信念修正的路径，为延迟反馈和部分可观测下的序贯决策提供了可解释的优化思路，对量化交易中的策略适应问题有参考价值。
cards.title: 语言模型智能体的策略记忆与信念修正用于非平稳配对交易

cards.description: 该研究提出CEEMDAN-SE-SSA-VMGL框架，针对现有CEEMDAN混合模型的高频模态混叠与波动异质性未匹配问题，引入样本熵聚类、奇异谱分析去噪及可微分GARCH层调制LSTM遗忘门，在五条中美金融序列上相对最佳基准降低9%至24%的预测误差。
cards.originalTitle: A decomposition-integration framework coupling singular spectrum analysis with a volatility-adaptive LSTM for stock price forecasting
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes CEEMDAN-SE-SSA-VMGL to address high-frequency mode mixing and unmatched volatility heterogeneity in existing CEEMDAN hybrids, combining sample-entropy clustering, singular spectrum analysis denoising, and a differentiable GARCH layer that modulates the LSTM forget gate; it reports 9%–24% lower forecasting error than the best benchmark across five US and Chinese financial series.
keyPointsEn: CEEMDAN decomposition is followed by sample-entropy-based clustering into high-, mid-, low-frequency and residual groups; the high-frequency group is reconstructed via SSA principal components to decouple pseudo-oscillatory modes.
VMGL embeds a differentiable GARCH(1,1) layer inside the LSTM cell as a risk gate, multiplicatively scaling forget-gate activation by conditional volatility while remaining end-to-end trainable.
On CSI 300, CSI 500, AAPL, GOOGL and S&P 500, forecasting error is 9%–24% lower than the best benchmark, with statistical tests supporting significance.
cards.summaryEn: The paper introduces a decomposition-integration framework that decomposes financial series with CEEMDAN, groups intrinsic mode functions via sample-entropy-driven K-means clustering, applies singular spectrum analysis to the high-frequency group to mitigate mode mixing, and designs VMGL, which embeds a differentiable GARCH(1,1) layer in the LSTM cell so memory decay adapts to instantaneous volatility. The authors report 9%–24% lower error than the best of eleven benchmarks and 60%–70% lower than a standard LSTM on five US and Chinese series, supported by Diebold-Mariano and MCS tests. These gains are the authors' reported results under their experimental setup and require independent replication and broader market validation.
keyPoints: CEEMDAN分解后按样本熵聚类为高、中、低频及残差组，高频组经SSA主成分重构以解耦伪振荡模态。
VMGL将可微分GARCH(1,1)层嵌入LSTM单元作为风险门，用条件波动率乘性缩放遗忘门激活，保持端到端训练。
在CSI 300、CSI 500、AAPL、GOOGL、S&P 500上，较最佳基准误差降低9%–24%，统计检验支持显著性。
cards.limitations: 证据仅基于论文所选五条中美金融序列与十一个基准架构，样本外时段、交易成本假设及回测细节未在摘要中展开；降低误差的幅度属特定实验设置下的报告，独立复现与跨市场、跨资产类别的稳健性仍需验证；不应将预测精度提升直接视为可交易收益。
cards.titleEn: Decomposition-Integration Framework Coupling SSA with a Volatility-Adaptive LSTM for Stock Price Forecasting
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to the five US and Chinese financial series and eleven benchmark architectures selected in the paper; out-of-sample periods, transaction-cost assumptions and backtest details are not elaborated in the abstract; reported error reductions are specific to the experimental setup, and independent replication plus robustness across markets and asset classes remain to be verified; improved forecasting accuracy should not be interpreted directly as tradable returns.
cards.summary: 论文提出一种分解-集成框架，用CEEMDAN分解金融序列，以样本熵驱动K-means聚类分组，对高频组应用奇异谱分析缓解模态混叠，并设计嵌入可微分GARCH(1,1)层的VMGL模型使LSTM记忆衰减随瞬时波动调整。作者报告在五个中美金融序列上，该模型较十一个基准中最佳者降低9%至24%误差，较标准LSTM降低60%至70%，并通过Diebold-Mariano与MCS检验。上述性能提升为作者基于其实验设置的报告，尚需独立复现与更广泛市场验证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work introduces volatility modeling as a differentiable gate within a decomposition-integration forecasting pipeline, offering a structured end-to-end approach to multi-scale, high-noise and non-stationary financial dynamics, with statistical tests and backtesting-based economic utility assessment.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作将波动率建模以可微分门控形式引入分解集成预测流程，为处理金融序列的多尺度、高噪声与非平稳波动提供了一种结构化的端到端方案，并给出了统计检验与回测层面的经济效用评估。
cards.title: 分解集成框架耦合SSA与波动自适应LSTM预测股价

cards.description: 该研究针对Polymarket薄订单簿的挑战，重构订单级数据并训练合作式多智能体做市策略；其价值在于揭示了奖励设计对分解式做市的关键作用及未实现正收益的证据边界。
cards.originalTitle: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Market Making on Prediction-Market Order Books
cards.descriptionEn: This study reconstructs order-level data from Polymarket's thin order books and trains cooperative multi-agent market-making policies; its value lies in highlighting the critical role of reward design in decomposed market making and the evidentiary boundary of no positive portfolio value.
keyPointsEn: Reconstructs Polymarket order-level data for simulation training and designs a cooperative multi-agent decomposition (quoter + risk manager) trained with recurrent IPPO.
Reward shaping (reward blending and post-fill markout) mitigates credit assignment and substantially improves the decomposed policy, yielding the best result.

The redesigned single-agent market maker quotes more frequently and incurs smaller held-out losses, but contributions of jointly changed observations, actions, and risk constraints are not separately identified.
No configuration establishes positive average portfolio value in periodic held-out evaluation, and each configuration is trained with one seed.
cards.summaryEn: The study reconstructs Polymarket L2 data into order-level LOBSTER format and trains market-making agents with JaxMARL-HFT on 417 real markets. The authors propose a cooperative decomposition into a quoter and a risk manager, and find that reward shaping (reward blending and post-fill markout) substantially improves the decomposed policy. However, the redesigned single-agent market maker quotes more frequently with smaller held-out losses, yet no configuration achieves positive average portfolio value in periodic held-out evaluation, and each configuration is trained with one seed.
keyPoints: 重构Polymarket订单级数据以支持仿真训练，并设计合作多智能体分解（报价者+风险管理者）用循环IPPO训练。
奖励塑形（奖励混合与成交后markout）缓解信用分配问题，使分解策略表现大幅提升并成为最佳结果。
重设计的单智能体做市商报价更频繁且持有期损失更小，但观察、动作与风险约束的联合改动贡献无法单独识别。
所有配置在留出市场的定期评估中均未实现正的平均组合价值，且每个配置仅训练一个种子。
cards.limitations: 仅使用一个随机种子训练每个配置，结果随机性未评估；联合改动观察空间、动作与风险约束的贡献无法单独归因；所有配置在定期留出评估中均未实现正的平均组合价值，无法支持策略盈利性结论；重构数据与仿真环境可能未完全反映真实市场摩擦。
cards.titleEn: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Market Making on Prediction-Market Order Books
cards.limitationsEn: Each configuration is trained with only one random seed, so stochasticity is not assessed; contributions of jointly changed observation space, actions, and risk constraints cannot be separately attributed; no configuration achieves positive average portfolio value in periodic held-out evaluation, so no profitability conclusion is supported; reconstructed data and simulation environment may not fully capture real market frictions.
cards.summary: 研究将Polymarket的L2数据重构为订单级LOBSTER格式，并在417个真实市场上用JaxMARL-HFT训练做市智能体。作者提出将做市分解为报价者与风险管理者两个合作智能体，并发现奖励塑形（奖励混合与成交后markout）能显著改善分解策略的表现。但单智能体重设计虽报价更频繁且持有期损失更小，所有配置均未在定期留出评估中实现正的平均组合价值，且仅使用一个随机种子训练。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides a reusable data reconstruction, simulation environment, and evaluation protocol for prediction-market making, and explicitly identifies the key role of reward design in multi-agent decomposition; meanwhile, the negative result of no positive portfolio value delineates the current evidentiary boundary and prevents overinterpretation.
cards.whyItMatters: 为预测市场做市提供了可复用的数据重构、仿真环境与评估协议，并明确指出奖励设计在多智能体分解中的关键作用；同时以未实现正收益的负面结果划定了当前方法的证据边界，避免过度解读。
cards.title: 合作多智能体强化学习在预测市场做市中的应用研究

cards.description: 该研究提出一种博弈论框架，使大语言模型无需微调即可通过上下文经验学习动态反制策略，并用纳什均衡作为评估基准。其新意在于将诈骗者与反诈 baiting 的交互建模为双人博弈，并释放带策略标签的对话数据集，为主动反诈提供了可量化的策略优化路径。
cards.originalTitle: Game of Phones: Harnessing Game Theory and LLMs in 'Bot Wars' to Counteract Phone Scams
cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces a game-theoretic framework that lets large language models learn dynamic counter-strategies through in-context experience without fine-tuning, using Nash equilibrium as an evaluation benchmark. Its novelty lies in modeling scammer–baiter interactions as a two-player game and releasing a dialogue dataset with turn-level strategy labels, offering a quantifiable path for proactive anti-scam strategy optimization.
keyPointsEn: The framework models scammer–baiter interactions as a two-player game with empirically grounded strategies and utility functions, using Nash equilibrium as a formal benchmark for evaluating learned behavior.
Across 300 simulated dialogues and three LLM architectures, adaptive strategy selection aligns 28.9–79.7% closer to Nash equilibrium than non-adaptive baselines.
LLMs learn counter-strategies through in-context experience without fine-tuning; the study releases code and an annotated dataset of 300 dialogues with turn-level strategy labels and utility scores.
cards.summaryEn: The research models interactions between phone scammers and automated scam-baiting agents as a two-player game, with empirically grounded strategies and utility functions, and uses Nash equilibrium as a formal benchmark for learned behavior. Across 300 simulated dialogues and three LLM architectures, adaptive strategy selection aligns 28.9–79.7% closer to Nash equilibrium than non-adaptive baselines. The authors present this as a viable framework for dynamic LLM counter-strategies without fine-tuning, and release code plus an annotated dataset of 300 dialogues with turn-level strategy labels and utility scores.
keyPoints: 框架将诈骗者与baiting代理的交互建模为双人博弈，策略与效用函数有实证依据，纳什均衡作为评估学习行为的正式基准。
在300段模拟对话和三种LLM架构中，自适应策略选择比非自适应基线更接近纳什均衡，提升幅度为28.9%至79.7%。
LLM通过上下文经验学习反制策略，无需微调；研究公开了代码和带轮次策略标签与效用分数的300段对话数据集。
cards.limitations: 证据基于300段模拟对话和三种LLM架构，并非真实电话诈骗场景的实地部署结果；效用函数和策略的实证依据程度、模拟环境与真实诈骗者行为的差距、以及纳什均衡作为基准的适用边界，均需进一步验证；未报告真实诈骗者资源消耗或诈骗成功率变化的现场数据。
cards.titleEn: Game-Theoretic Framework Enables LLMs to Learn Counter-Scam Strategies
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on 300 simulated dialogues and three LLM architectures, not field deployments against real phone scams; the extent of empirical grounding for utility functions and strategies, the gap between simulated and real scammer behavior, and the applicability boundaries of Nash equilibrium as a benchmark all require further validation; no field data on real scammer resource depletion or changes in scam success rates are reported.
cards.summary: 研究将电话诈骗者与自动反诈 baiting 代理的交互建模为双人博弈，策略与效用函数有实证依据，并以纳什均衡作为学习行为的正式基准。在300段模拟对话和三种LLM架构上，自适应策略选择比非自适应基线更接近纳什均衡，提升幅度为28.9%至79.7%。作者认为这为无需微调的LLM动态反制策略提供了可行框架，并公开了代码和带轮次策略标签与效用分数的数据集。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Phone scams impose substantial and growing costs on individuals and financial systems, while existing countermeasures impose no resource cost on perpetrators. The framework explores automated baiting to deplete scammer operational capacity and introduces Nash equilibrium as a quantifiable evaluation benchmark, offering a reproducible research path for proactive anti-scam strategy learning.
cards.whyItMatters: 电话诈骗对个人和金融系统造成显著且持续增长的成本，而现有反制措施不消耗诈骗者资源。该框架探索通过自动化baiting消耗诈骗者运营能力，并引入纳什均衡作为可量化评估基准，为主动反诈策略学习提供了可复现的研究路径。
cards.title: 博弈论框架让LLM学会反制电话诈骗

cards.description: 该研究提出LOBGrad，将自回归循环神经网络编码器与条件扩散模型结合，用于限价订单簿的概率预测，并首次为一步DDPM噪声预测目标建立了超额风险oracle不等式，在BTC/USDT、GOOGL和META数据上优于无编码器消融版本。
cards.originalTitle: Probabilistic Limit Order Book Forecasting with Conditional Diffusion Models
cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces LOBGrad, a conditional DDPM framework combining an autoregressive RNN encoder with a diffusion generator for probabilistic limit order book forecasting, establishes an excess-risk oracle inequality for the one-step DDPM noise-prediction objective, and shows improvements over an encoder-free ablation on BTC/USDT, GOOGL, and META.
keyPointsEn: LOBGrad combines an autoregressive RNN encoder with a conditional DDPM for probabilistic limit order book forecasting.
An excess-risk oracle inequality is established for the one-step DDPM noise-prediction objective under exponential mixing and regularity assumptions.
On BTC/USDT, GOOGL, and META, it improves over the encoder-free ablation on all reported queue metrics and reproduces stylized facts of LOB microstructure.
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The authors propose LOBGrad, which couples an RNN encoder with a diffusion generator, and prove an excess-risk oracle inequality for the one-step DDPM noise-prediction objective under exponential mixing and regularity assumptions. Experiments on three datasets show LOBGrad improves over its encoder-free diffusion ablation on all reported queue metrics and is competitive with other baselines. Author view: Under contractive dynamics, the dependence on conditioning-window length can be reduced to dependence on latent-state dimension, and the generated forecasts show potential value in a downstream task.
keyPoints: LOBGrad将自回归RNN编码器与条件DDPM结合，实现限价订单簿的概率预测。
在指数混合与正则性假设下，为一步DDPM噪声预测目标建立了超额风险oracle不等式。
在BTC/USDT、GOOGL和META上，所有报告的队列指标均优于无编码器消融，并复现LOB微观结构典型事实。
cards.limitations: 理论保证依赖于指数混合、正则性和收缩动态等假设，实际市场未必满足；实证仅覆盖BTC/USDT、GOOGL和META三个数据集，队列指标之外的表现未充分报告；下游任务仅为风格化示例，生成预测的实际经济价值需进一步验证。
cards.titleEn: Probabilistic Limit Order Book Forecasting with Conditional Diffusion Models
cards.limitationsEn: Theoretical guarantees rely on exponential mixing, regularity, and contractive dynamics assumptions that may not hold in real markets; empirical evidence covers only BTC/USDT, GOOGL, and META, with limited reporting beyond queue metrics; the downstream task is a stylized illustration, and the practical economic value of generated forecasts requires further validation.
cards.summary: 文章事实：作者提出LOBGrad框架，结合RNN编码器与扩散生成器，并在指数混合与正则性假设下证明了一步DDPM噪声预测目标的超额风险oracle不等式。实验显示在三个数据集上，LOBGrad在所有报告的队列指标上优于无编码器的扩散消融版本，并与其他基线具有竞争力。作者观点：在收缩动态下，条件窗口长度的依赖可简化为潜在状态维度的依赖；生成预测在下游任务中具有潜在价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a probabilistic modeling framework with both theoretical guarantees and empirical improvements for limit order book forecasting, which can support more reliable evaluation of execution strategies and quantitative market risk, though applicability depends on assumptions and data scope.
cards.whyItMatters: 为限价订单簿预测提供了兼具理论保证与实证改进的概率建模框架，有助于更可靠地评估执行策略和量化市场风险，但其应用需考虑假设条件与数据范围。
cards.title: 条件扩散模型实现限价订单簿概率预测

cards.description: NIOCIS 将工具使用智能体的执行日志压缩为循环折叠的动作图，通过小模型单次输出类型化选项分布，以极低延迟替代耗时的大模型逐跳推理。
cards.originalTitle: NIOCIS: Typed-Decision Next-Hop Routing with Node-Conditioned Option Spaces for Tool-Use Agents
cards.descriptionEn: NIOCIS compresses tool-use agent logs into a loop-collapsed action graph and uses a small model to emit a typed option distribution in one pass, replacing costly per-hop LLM reasoning with very low latency.
keyPointsEn: On 3,875 held-out decisions, the typed encoder matched the logged next hop 32.2% of the time in 10 ms, while each LLM hop takes 2.2 s.
Fine-tuned jpt-4b reaches 31.9% accuracy versus 9.9% zero-shot, with a paired test showing no significant difference (p=0.68).
Option-space ablation attributes the gain to per-node candidate restriction (+3.5 points over a flat catalog) rather than graph traversal.
cards.summaryEn: NIOCIS is a routing layer that folds execution logs into a loop-collapsed action graph and uses a small model to output a calibrated distribution over typed options in a single pass, without generating text. On 1,615 production security-operations episodes, its encoder matched 32.2% of held-out next-hop decisions in 10 ms, versus 2.2 s per LLM hop. The authors argue the typed layer is chosen for cost, not a separated performance lead.
keyPoints: 在 3,875 个留出决策上，类型化编码器 10 毫秒内匹配记录下一跳的 32.2%，而 LLM 每跳耗时 2.2 秒。
微调后的 jpt-4b 达到 31.9% 准确率，零样本为 9.9%，配对检验未发现显著差异（p=0.68）。
选项空间消融显示，增益来自每节点候选限制（较平坦目录提升 3.5 个百分点），而非图遍历。
cards.limitations: 跨轨迹留一法测试表明，随着状态键更具体，发布状态的天花板仅 25.6–44.9%，重复状态的分歧常多于一致；置信门控级联在升级臂为零样本替代时反而损失一致性；结论基于特定生产安全运营数据，泛化性待验证。
cards.titleEn: NIOCIS Routing Layer: Typed Decisions and Node-Conditioned Option Spaces for Tool-Use Agents
cards.limitationsEn: A cross-trace leave-one-out test puts the ceiling of the released state at only 25.6–44.9% as the state key grows more specific, with repeated states disagreeing more often than agreeing; a confidence-gated cascade loses agreement when the escalation arm is a zero-shot stand-in; conclusions are based on specific production security-operations data and generalization remains to be validated.
cards.summary: NIOCIS 是一个路由层，把执行日志折叠成循环折叠的动作图，用小型模型单次前向输出类型化选项的校准分布，而不生成文本。在生产安全运营的 1,615 个回合上，其编码器以 10 毫秒匹配 32.2% 的留出下一步决策，对比 LLM 每跳 2.2 秒。作者认为类型化层的选择基于成本，而非分离的性能领先。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work quantifies the cost-accuracy trade-off of replacing per-hop LLM reasoning with a lightweight typed routing layer, offering reference boundary evidence for low-latency deployment of tool-use agents.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作量化了用轻量类型化路由层替代 LLM 逐跳推理的成本与精度取舍，为工具使用智能体的低延迟部署提供了可参考的边界证据。
cards.title: NIOCIS 路由层：以类型化决策与节点条件选项空间优化工具智能体

cards.description: 该研究通过2627笔平仓交易，检验四个AI交易代理是否遵守策略与风控规则，并提供可复用的代理评估工具，帮助在赋予代理自主权或资金前区分规则遵循与运气。
cards.originalTitle: The Control Layer Behind Rule-Following Agents Trading Across Market Conditions
cards.descriptionEn: The study examines whether four AI trading agents followed their strategies and risk rules across 2,627 closed positions and offers a reusable agent evaluation toolkit to distinguish rule-following from luck before granting autonomy or capital.
keyPointsEn: All four agents maintained high rule adherence, with 97.5% of gross loss kept within declared stops.
Profitability was linked to how often agents won relative to their break-even win rates, not rule adherence alone.
23 of 24 runs respected the position limit, with logs documenting the size and duration of the exception.
cards.summaryEn: The study analyzed 2,627 closed positions from four AI trading agents between February and August 2026; most were simulated against live prices, with 18% real Hyperliquid orders. Rule adherence was high across all four agents, including the unprofitable one, and profitability tracked how often agents won relative to their break-even win rates. The authors argue discipline should be an entry test for capital allocation, but stress that trade-level results are not account-level returns or proof of a lasting edge.
keyPoints: 四个代理均保持高规则遵守度，97.5%的毛损失控制在声明止损内。
盈利能力与代理相对于盈亏平衡胜率的获胜频率相关，而非仅由规则遵守决定。
24次运行中23次遵守持仓上限，日志记录了例外的大小与持续时间。
cards.limitations: 交易级结果不代表账户级回报，也不能证明持续优势；多数头寸为模拟交易，仅18%涉及真实订单；结果基于特定资产范围和时段，策略间结果不同，不能直接推广为投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Rule Adherence Evaluation of Four Trading Agents: A New Toolkit to Separate Discipline from Luck
cards.limitationsEn: Trade-level results are not account-level returns and do not prove a lasting edge; most positions were simulated and only 18% involved real orders; findings are based on a specific asset universe and period, vary by strategy, and are not investment advice.
cards.summary: 研究分析了2026年2月至8月间四个AI交易代理的2627笔平仓头寸，多数为模拟交易，18%为真实Hyperliquid订单。结果显示四个代理规则遵守度均高，包括未盈利代理；盈利能力与相对盈亏平衡胜率的获胜频率相关。作者认为纪律应作为资金配置的入门测试，但强调交易级结果不等于账户级回报或持续优势。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides a rerunnable rule-adherence test toolkit for evaluating trading agents, helping to use discipline as an entry filter—not the only test—before granting autonomy or capital.
cards.whyItMatters: 为量化交易中的代理评估提供了可重跑的规则遵循检验工具，有助于在赋予代理自主权或资金前，将纪律作为入门筛选条件，而非唯一标准。
cards.title: 四交易代理规则遵守评估：新工具区分纪律与运气

cards.description: 该研究评估TimeGAN生成情景在Rachev比率组合优化中的可靠性，通过12只ETF比较历史、替换与混合策略，发现合成情景低估波动与尾部损失、扭曲依赖结构，且收益差异不显著。
cards.originalTitle: Rachev-Ratio Portfolio Optimization with TimeGAN Scenarios: Replacement versus Supplementation
cards.descriptionEn: This study evaluates the reliability of TimeGAN-generated scenarios in Rachev-ratio portfolio allocation using 12 ETFs, comparing historical, replacement, and hybrid policies; synthetic scenarios understate volatility and tail losses and distort dependence, with return differences not statistically significant.
keyPointsEn: Synthetic probability mass varies independently of draw count under a fixed training protocol, and optimal generator fidelity is not assumed.
TimeGAN scenarios understate volatility and tail losses and distort dependence; longer training improves reconstruction loss without improving cross-asset correlation accuracy.
Replacement raises turnover and is sensitive to the modified objective's denominator floor; all conditional generated-versus-historical return intervals include zero at the reference block length.
cards.summaryEn: The study uses TimeGAN scenarios for Rachev-ratio portfolio allocation under a fixed training protocol, comparing them with historical scenarios and hybrid policies. The author reports that synthetic scenarios understate volatility and tail losses, distort cross-asset dependence, and that replacement raises turnover and is sensitive to the modified objective's denominator floor. The paper concludes that, within the tested implementation, return differences between generated and historical scenarios have intervals including zero, so robust improvement from generated scenarios cannot be confirmed.
keyPoints: 合成情景的概率质量在固定训练协议下随抽取次数独立变化，且生成器保真度未被假设为最优。
TimeGAN情景低估波动与尾部损失并扭曲依赖结构；延长训练仅改善重构损失，未提升跨资产相关性精度。
替换策略提高换手率并受修正目标分母下限影响；所有条件生成与历史收益区间在参考块长度下包含零。
cards.limitations: 证据基于12只ETF、五个训练种子及特定TimeGAN实现与训练协议，结论外推需谨慎；生成误差与投资绩效的关联为探索性，未识别因果渠道；收益、夏普与尾部比率区间包含零，统计显著性不足；分母下限调整未一致改善实现下行风险。
cards.titleEn: Reliability Comparison of TimeGAN Scenario Replacement versus Supplementation in Rachev-Ratio Portfolios
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on 12 ETFs, five training seeds, and a specific TimeGAN implementation and training protocol, so extrapolation requires caution; the association between generation error and investment performance is exploratory and does not identify a causal channel; intervals for returns, Sharpe, and realized tail ratios include zero, indicating insufficient statistical significance; adjusting the denominator floor does not uniformly improve realized downside risk.
cards.summary: 研究在固定训练协议下，使用TimeGAN生成情景进行Rachev比率组合配置，并与历史情景及混合策略对比。作者报告合成情景低估波动和尾部损失、扭曲跨资产依赖，且替换策略换手率更高、对目标函数分母下限敏感。论文结论认为，在测试实现中，生成情景与历史情景的收益差异区间包含零，无法确认生成情景能带来稳健改进。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study highlights financial model risk arising from the interaction of imperfect generated scenarios and a tail-sensitive allocation criterion, suggesting that fidelity, numerical behavior, and realized outcomes should be jointly evaluated before adopting generative scenarios for portfolio optimization, rather than relying on training loss alone.
cards.whyItMatters: 研究揭示了不完美生成情景与尾部敏感配置准则交互产生的金融模型风险，提示在采用生成式情景进行组合优化前需联合评估保真度、数值行为与实现结果，而非仅依赖训练损失。
cards.title: TimeGAN情景替换与补充在Rachev比率组合中的可靠性比较

cards.description: 该课程介绍智能体长期运行时上下文累积重复、矛盾或过期信息导致模型表现下降的“上下文腐化”问题，并给出可操作的工程方法。其价值在于用 Python 从零构建智能体框架，将检索、上下文管理与记忆作为独立模块来设计，而非仅依赖更大的上下文窗口。
cards.originalTitle: Learn to build better AI Agents through better context
cards.descriptionEn: The course addresses "context rot": as agents run longer, repeated, contradictory, or stale information accumulates in their context and model performance degrades. Its value lies in building agent harnesses from scratch in Python and treating retrieval, context management, and memory as explicit engineering modules rather than relying only on larger context windows.
keyPointsEn: The course starts from Context Rot: growing context introduces repeated, contradictory, or stale information that hurts model performance.

Three teaching threads: agentic search across multiple sources and tools with traces used for evals of tool selection; context management via pruning, compaction, and scratchpads; agentic memory that stores user feedback as reusable memories updated across sessions.
Implementation emphasizes building agent harnesses from scratch in Python, not only calling existing frameworks.
cards.summaryEn: DeepLearning.AI offers a free Context Engineering course taught by Jeff Huber with guest Drew Breunig, addressing the phenomenon Chroma calls Context Rot: the longer an agent works, the more repeated, contradictory, or stale information builds up in its context, and models perform worse as context grows. Students build agent harnesses from scratch in Python and practice agentic search, context management, and agentic memory. The Context Rot problem description and the course's value are source claims; no quantitative impact is given in the input.
keyPoints: 课程以 Context Rot 为问题起点：上下文增长会引入重复、矛盾或过期信息，从而拖累模型表现。
教学内容覆盖三条主线：用多来源、多工具做智能体检索并借轨迹评估改进工具选择；用剪枝、压缩和草稿板管理上下文；把用户反馈存为可复用记忆并跨会话更新。
实现方式强调用 Python 从零构建智能体框架，而非仅调用现成框架。
cards.limitations: 输入材料仅为一门课程的宣传介绍，未提供 Context Rot 的量化实验结果、基准对比、适用模型范围或失败案例；“上下文越大表现越差”的程度与条件需以原始研究为准。课程所授方法的效果取决于具体任务、检索源与评估设计，输入未给出效果数据或投资、部署建议。
cards.titleEn: Context Engineering Course Targets Agent Context Rot
cards.limitationsEn: The input is only a promotional course description and provides no quantitative Context Rot results, benchmark comparisons, supported model scope, or failure cases; the extent and conditions of "worse performance as context grows" must be checked against the original research. Method effectiveness depends on the specific task, retrieval sources, and evaluation design; the input gives no performance data or investment/deployment advice.
cards.summary: DeepLearning.AI 推出由 Jeff Huber 主讲、Drew Breunig 客座的“上下文工程”免费课程，针对智能体工作时间越长、上下文中重复、矛盾或过期信息越多、模型表现越差的现象（Chroma 团队称之为 Context Rot）。课程要求学员用 Python 从零构建智能体框架，练习智能体检索、上下文管理和智能体记忆三类技能。上述“上下文腐化”问题与课程价值属于来源陈述，其量化影响程度未在输入中给出。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Agents working on long tasks and multi-turn sessions keep accumulating context; without management, stale retrieved information, conflicting conclusions, and redundancy can degrade output quality. Treating context as an engineering object helps deliver the right information in the right format at the right time under a limited context budget, and makes user feedback reusable across sessions.
cards.whyItMatters: 智能体在长任务和多轮会话中会不断累积上下文，若不加管理，检索到的旧信息、相互冲突的结论和冗余内容会降低输出质量。把上下文当作需要主动设计的工程对象，有助于在有限上下文预算下给出“正确信息、正确格式、正确时机”，并让用户反馈在跨会话中可复用。
cards.title: 上下文工程课程：应对智能体上下文腐化
